pairs.question: Qui igitur is est?
pairs.answer: Aut M. Brutus aut C. Cassius aut uterque.
pairs.derivation: Cicero asks who the needed commander is (Qui igitur is est?) and answers it himself in the immediately following sentence. The answer ends at the first full stop after 'uterque'; what follows ('Decernerem plane sicut multa...') turns to elaborating on why Brutus is held in Greece, i.e. digression rather than the direct answer. Section marker [XI] and the [26] marker stripped.
